_comment: ERA5 Pakistan bulk downloader configuration. Secrets (CDS key, Google Drive OAuth) are NOT stored here: use env vars / GitHub secrets / secrets.local.json.
_area_comment: North, West, South, East in degrees. Pakistan spans ~23.6-37.1N, 60.9-77.8E; this box adds a ~0.5 deg margin.
_period_comment: start/end are YYYY-MM (inclusive). end='auto' = last complete month that ended at least auto_end_lag_days ago.
_storage_comment: auto = Google Drive if GDRIVE_* credentials exist, otherwise 'none' (submit-only: you pull results manually from https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/requests). Other values: drive | local | none
_pacing_comment: CDS needs ~0.5-2 h per request: a request is not even polled until min_age_before_poll_minutes have passed, then at most every poll_interval_minutes.

pressure_levels._groups_comment: One request = one month x one group. CDS limit is 60000 fields/request; 2 vars x 37 levels x 24 h x 31 d = 55056.

model_levels._comment: MARS (tape) ERA5 model-level analysis, all 137 levels, hourly. One request = one day (CDS cost 105216 of 120000 limit). 75 crwc,76 cswc,77 etadot,129 z,130 t,131 u,132 v,133 q,135 w,138 vo,152 lnsp,155 d,203 o3,246 clwc,247 ciwc,248 cc
